summary: Join our IFRS 9 Training Course to master international financial reporting standards. Gain essential skills for accurate financial reporting and compliance.
lede: IFRS 9 training covers how to classify and measure financial instruments, assess expected credit losses, and apply hedge accounting. Designed for finance, credit risk, treasury, audit, and reporting professionals, it supports practical reporting tasks through SPPI assessments, three-stage ECL modeling using credit risk parameters and scenarios, and preparation of hedge documentation and disclosures.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the accuracy, compliance, and strategic oversight of financial instrument reporting within corporate and banking environments.
modules: Foundations of IFRS 9 and Transition Dynamics
Classification and Measurement of Financial Assets
The IFRS 9 Impairment Pillar: ECL Framework
Modeling Credit Risk Parameters: PD, LGD, and EAD
Hedge Accounting and Risk Management Alignment
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial accounting principles and familiarity with the basic structure of a balance sheet and income statement. Prior experience with the previous IAS 39 standard or general credit risk concepts is beneficial but not required. No programming knowledge is needed, though proficiency in Microsoft Excel is recommended for the modeling exercises.
